# hevo_pipeline_objects (Data Source)

Lists a Pipeline's objects with the names `hevo_pipeline_objects` takes. By default only objects whose selection can change are listed; a source can have tens of thousands of others.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The names to use as keys in the hevo_pipeline_objects resource.
data "hevo_pipeline_objects" "postgres" {
  pipeline_id = hevo_pipeline.postgres.id
}

output "object_names" {
  value = data.hevo_pipeline_objects.postgres.objects[*].fully_qualified_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_id` (String) The Pipeline, such as `hevo_pipeline.x.id`.

### Optional

- `statuses` (List of String) Keep only objects in these statuses. Defaults to the ones whose selection can change: `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`, `RESETTING`, `BLOCKED`, `INCONSISTENT`.

### Read-Only

- `objects` (Attributes List) The objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) The name `hevo_pipeline_objects` takes, for example `shop.public.orders` for Postgres.
- `load_mode` (String) `MERGE`, `APPEND` or `HISTORY_TRACKING`.
- `name` (String) The object's own name.
- `selected` (Boolean) Whether it is replicated.
- `status` (String) For example `ACTIVE` (selected) or `INACTIVE` (not selected).
